question.prompt: The fully booked boundary test needs a runnable detail-page URL for a package that currently has no seats left, which the corpus did not supply.

options.label: Fill variable
options.detail: Provide the real fully booked package detail page by filling {{fully_booked_package_detail_url}} before running the test.

options.label: Rework discovery
options.detail: Revise the test to discover a fully booked package from another known entry page.

options.label: Drop boundary run
options.detail: Do not run the fully booked boundary test until a concrete detail URL is available.

content.risk_rationale: Without a concrete fully booked package detail URL, the zero-capacity boundary that suppresses the form cannot be exercised in a runnable browser test.
